summary: Every attendee gets an RFID wristband for entry. VIP and Top Shelf also receive a commemorative laminate for express lanes and lounge access.

items.name: RFID Festival Wristband
items.description: Your actual admission credential. One wristband per pass purchase. A 4-day pass uses one wristband for all four days.
features: Registration code on back of RFID saddle

registration.instructions: Register before entering. Use the code on the back of the RFID saddle plus your Front Gate order number.

items.name: VIP Commemorative Laminate
items.description: Separate from the RFID wristband. Used for dedicated VIP entry lanes and VIP lounge access.

items.name: Top Shelf VIP Laminate + Wristband branding
items.description: Top Shelf receives a commemorative laminate and wristband for the most exclusive areas including the Skybox and Top Shelf entrance.
features: All-inclusive drinks in Top Shelf area

shipping.note: Orders ship in batches; tracking arrives when your order ships.

willCall.location: Box Office & Will Call near Highland Entrance

rules: 4-day passes are not transferable between people
Admission, camping, and parking are sold separately
Resale above face value voids pass without refund
